# Add climate and site predictors to training data points

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(tinytex.verbose = TRUE)
require(tidyverse)
require (ggplot2)
require(data.table)
require(DBI)
library(purrr)
#require(SIndexR)
require(climr)
require(tictoc)
require(spatialEco)
climr::list_vars()
```

## Read in SIBEC data from ACCESS database

```{r SIBEC data import}
# # Read in sitetools SI for update of SIBEC data
# sitetools <- fread("./sitetools_calculated/SIBEC_SI50_15June2025.csv") %>% mutate(PlotNumber = str_remove(PlotNumber, "^SI_")) %>% dplyr::rename(Zone = Location)# remove the SI_ to the plot number for sitetools
sibec_master <- dbConnect(odbc::odbc(), .connection_string = "Driver={Microsoft Access Driver (*.mdb, *.accdb)}; DBQ=D:/OneDrive - Government of BC/SIBEC_Modelled/SIBEC_files/SIBEC_2026_VPRO_cleaned.accdb;")
sibec  <- dbReadTable(sibec_master, "SIBEC_All_2026_ENV")
sibec.tree  <- dbReadTable(sibec_master, "SIBEC_All_2026_Trees")
sibec.info  <- dbReadTable(sibec_master, "SIBEC_All_2026_TreePlot")
#sibec.bgc <- dbReadTable(sibec_master, "SIBEC_BGC_2025")
#dbWriteTable(sibec_master, "Sitetools_SI50", sitetools, overwrite = TRUE, batch_rows = 1) # write the sitetools SI50 to the SIBEC database
#SI_raw  <- dbReadTable(sibec_master, "SIBEC_Analysis_Data")
dbDisconnect(sibec_master)
sibec.info <- sibec.info %>% mutate(PlotNumber, BECSiteUnit)# remove the SI_ to the plot number for sitetools
## remove some remaining problems with the old data
sibec.tree2 <- sibec.tree %>% mutate(diffSI = ifelse(!is.na(SiteIndex) & abs(SiteIndex - SI50)>1, "diff", "same")) %>% filter(diffSI == "same") %>% select(-diffSI)
#sibec.anal <- fread("./data/SIBEC_data_2025_cleaned.csv")
sibec.env <- left_join(sibec, sibec.info) %>% select(PlotNumber, BECSiteUnit, rSMR = MoistureRegime, SNR = NutrientRegime, Latitude, Longitude, Elevation, SlopeGradient, Aspect) %>%   
  mutate(BGC = str_extract(BECSiteUnit, "^[^/]+")) %>%   mutate(Zone = str_extract(BECSiteUnit,"[A-Z]+")) |> 
  mutate(rSMR = as.numeric(rSMR))#, Aspect, SlopeGradient) %>% mutate_if(is.integer, as.numeric) %>% 
  #mutate(aspect.class = ifelse(SlopeGradient <= 20, "Gradual",
                           #ifelse(Aspect == 0, "Flat",    
                             #ifelse(Aspect == 999, "Flat",
                                 # ifelse(Aspect >= 315 | Aspect < 90, "Cold",
                                 #      ifelse(Aspect >= 90 & Aspect < 135, "Neutral",
                                 #             ifelse(Aspect >= 135 & Aspect < 290, "Warm",
                                 #                    ifelse(Aspect >= 290 & Aspect < 315, "Neutral", NA))))))#))
                                                           
xx <- unique(sibec.tree$TreeSpp)
#sibec.anal <- merge(sibec.tree, sibec.info, by = c("PlotNumber")) 
sibec.anal <- merge(sibec.tree, sibec.env, by = c("PlotNumber")) %>%  dplyr::rename(`BHAge` = CountAge, `Height` = TotalHtCalc )%>% mutate(purpose = "sibec") %>% filter(BHAge >14 & BHAge < 120) |> 
  select(PlotNumber, TreeSpp, Zone, BGC, SS_NoSpace = BECSiteUnit, rSMR, SNR, Latitude, Longitude, Elevation, SlopeGradient, Aspect, SI50, purpose) %>% drop_na()# |> 
  #mutate(TreeSpp = ifelse(Zone %in% c("CDF", "CWH", "MH"), paste0(TreeSpp, "c"), TreeSpp))




bgc.grid.pts <- fread("D:/OneDrive - Government of BC/CommonTables/BGCv13_3_2km_gridpts.csv") %>%
  distinct(BGC, id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%   # guarantee unique locations
  group_by(BGC) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    PlotNumber = as.character(id),
    BGC,
    BGC_LABEL,
    Latitude = ycoord,
    Longitude = xcoord,
    Elevation = elev,
    Zone = str_extract(BGC, "[A-Z]+"),
    SlopeGradient = 0,
    Aspect = 0,
    SI50 = 0.5,
    purpose = "edaphic_boundary"
  )

```

### Read in other site index data sources
AMAT
Off-site trials
```{r}
amat.sibec <- fread("./data/AMAT_SI50_for_SIBEC.csv") %>% mutate(rSMR = as.numeric(MoistureRegime), SNR = as.character(NutrientRegime), purpose = "amat") %>% filter(SI50>0) |> select(-MoistureRegime, -NutrientRegime)

sibec.anal <- bind_rows(sibec.anal, amat.sibec)
```

## Synthetic data to bound edaphic space (SMR 0 and SMR8)
Add edaphic limits to tree species

```{r}
set.seed(123)
spp.list = unique(sibec.anal$TreeSpp)
bgc.list = unique(sibec.anal$BGC)
#synth.dat <- fread("./data/Edaphic_sites_data_2025.csv")
synth.dat <- bgc.grid.pts %>% slice_sample(n = 10, by="BGC") %>% select(PlotNumber, Zone, BGC, Latitude, Longitude, Elevation) %>% mutate(SlopeGradient = 0, Aspect = 0, SI50 = 0.5, purpose = "model") # add an id column for later use
bgc.all <- unique(synth.dat$BGC)
### this is from the grid of points to be predicted to fill SIBEC model
# keep a single example of each BGC, rSMR, SNR combination
# synth.dat <- synth.dat %>%
#   select(-id, -Latitude) %>%
#   distinct(BGC, rSMR, SNR, .keep_all = TRUE)
# for rSMR = 0 in synth.dat create a table with a record for each species in spp.list with a SI50 = 0 including all the other columns

SNR = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E")
rSMR = c(0, 8)
new_records <- expand.grid(
  SNR = SNR,
  rSMR = rSMR,
  TreeSpp = unlist(spp.list, use.names = FALSE),
  BGC = bgc.all
)
#synth.rsmr07 <- synth.dat %>% filter(rSMR %in% c(0, 8))
synth.rsmr08 <- left_join(synth.dat, new_records,  by = c("BGC")) %>% mutate(SS_NoSpace = paste0(BGC, "/", rSMR, SNR), PlotNumber = as.character(PlotNumber), rSMR = as.numeric(rSMR), purpose = "edaphic_boundary")
#fwrite(synth.rsmr08, "./data/synthetic_data_2025.csv")
synth.rsmr08 <- synth.rsmr08 %>%
  select(all_of(names(sibec.anal)))

sibec.anal <- bind_rows(sibec.anal, synth.rsmr08) 
xx <- sibec.anal %>% filter(BGC == "ESSFmcw")
# add in a tree record for each rSMR = 0 
## read in suitability table and add SI50=0 across all edaphic positions when a species is out of range
```

## Add in points for locations outside the range of species to capture climate limits
Add in alpine sites for SI50=0.5 for cold limits
Add in low coastal BGC, BG, IDF as heat/drought tolerances for species

```{r}
source("./_functions/make_boundary_data.R")

TreeSpp <- unlist(
  spp.list,
  use.names = FALSE
)
#all species in all alpine = cold limit for any tree species
alpine.dat <- make_boundary_data(
  grid_data = bgc.grid.pts,
  bgc_filter =    grepl("^BAFA|^CMA|^IMA", BGC),
  tree_spp = TreeSpp,
  bgc_all = bgc.all,
  #snr = c("A", "C", "E"),
    #rsmr = c(1, 3, 4, 5, 7),
  snr = c("C"),
  rsmr = c(3, 4),
  n_per_bgc = 10,
  template = sibec.anal
)
## zero site index for these species in these subzones = coast high elevation heat/drought limits
c_montane.trees <- c("Ba", "Yc", "Bl")
c_montane_spp <- TreeSpp[TreeSpp %in% c_montane.trees]
montane.bgc <- c("CWHdm3", "CDFmm", "CWHds1")
c_montane.dat <- make_boundary_data(
  grid_data = bgc.grid.pts,
  bgc_filter =    BGC %in% montane.bgc,
  tree_spp = c_montane_spp,
  bgc_all = bgc.all,
  #snr = c("A", "C", "E"),
    #rsmr = c(1, 3, 4, 5, 7),
  snr = c("C"),
  rsmr = c(3, 4),
  n_per_bgc = 5,
  template = sibec.anal
)

## zero site index for any but these species in these subzones
MH.trees <- c("Hm", "Bl", "Ba", "Yc")
MH_spp <- TreeSpp[!TreeSpp %in% MH.trees]

MH.dat <- make_boundary_data(
  grid_data = bgc.grid.pts,
  bgc_filter =    grepl("^MH", BGC_LABEL) &    substr(BGC_LABEL, 7, 7) == "p",
  tree_spp = MH_spp,
  bgc_all = bgc.all,
  #snr = c("A", "C", "E"),
    #rsmr = c(1, 3, 4, 5, 7),
  snr = c("C"),
  rsmr = c(3, 4),
  n_per_bgc = 5,
  template = sibec.anal
)


BG.trees <- c("Py", "Fd", "At", "Ac", "Ep")
BG_spp <- TreeSpp[!TreeSpp %in% BG.trees]

BG.dat <- make_boundary_data(
  grid_data = bgc.grid.pts,
  bgc_filter =    grepl("^BG", BGC_LABEL),
  tree_spp = BG_spp,
  bgc_all = bgc.all,
  #snr = c("A", "C", "E"),
    #rsmr = c(1, 3, 4, 5, 7),
  snr = c("C"),
  rsmr = c(3, 4),
  n_per_bgc = 5,
  template = sibec.anal
)
IDF.trees <- c("Py", "Fd", "At", "Ac", "Ep", "Bg", "Lw", "Sx", "Pl", "Pw", "Cw")
IDF_spp <- TreeSpp[!TreeSpp %in% IDF.trees]

IDF.dat <- make_boundary_data(
  grid_data = bgc.grid.pts,
  bgc_filter =    grepl("^IDF", BGC_LABEL),
  tree_spp = IDF_spp,
  bgc_all = bgc.all,
  #snr = c("A", "C", "E"),
    #rsmr = c(1, 3, 4, 5, 7),
  snr = c("C"),
  rsmr = c(3, 4),
  n_per_bgc = 10,
  template = sibec.anal
)

sibec.anal <- bind_rows(sibec.anal, alpine.dat, c_montane.dat, MH.dat, BG.dat, IDF.dat) #parkland.dat,, CDF.dat, woodland.dat, boreal.dat

xx <- sibec.anal |> filter(TreeSpp == "Fd", rSMR == 4, SI50 == 0.5) |> select(BGC,TreeSpp, rSMR, SNR, SI50)
yy <- bgc.grid.pts |> filter (grepl("^IDF", BGC_LABEL))

xx <- sibec.anal |> count(PlotNumber,TreeSpp)

xx <- sibec.anal |> filter(BGC == "MSdc1")
```



Build a grid of edatopic positions for prediction of SIBEC values
```{r}
spp.list = unique(sibec.anal$TreeSpp)
bgc.list = unique(sibec.anal$BGC)
#synth.dat <- fread("./data/Edaphic_sites_data_2025.csv")
climate.points <- fread("D:/OneDrive - Government of BC/CommonTables/BGCv13_3_2km_gridpts.csv") %>% slice_sample(n = 5, by="BGC") %>% select(PlotNumber = id, BGC, Latitude = ycoord, Longitude = xcoord, Elevation = elev) %>% mutate(Zone = str_extract(BGC, "[A-Z]+"), SlopeGradient = 0, Aspect = 0, SI50 = 0.5)
SNR_code = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E")
rSMR_code = c(0,1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)

edatopic.grid  <- expand.grid(
  SNR= SNR_code,
  rSMR = rSMR_code,
  TreeSpp = unlist(spp.list, use.names = FALSE),
  BGC = bgc.all
)

edatopic.grid <- left_join(climate.points, edatopic.grid,  by = c("BGC")) %>% mutate(SS_NoSpace = paste0(BGC, "/", rSMR, SNR), PlotNumber = as.character(PlotNumber), rSMR = as.character(rSMR), SNR = as.character(SNR)) %>% mutate(purpose = "edatopic")
#sibec.anal <- bind_rows(sibec.anal, edatopic.grid)
#fwrite(synth.rsmr08, "./data/synthetic_data_2025.csv")
xx <- edatopic.grid %>% filter(BGC == "ESSFmcw")
```

source("./_functions/add_predictors_sibec.R")

source("./_functions/calc_solar.R")
source("./_functions/add_sibec_attributes.R")

sibec.anal2 <- add_predictors_sibec(
  sibec.anal,
  add_asmr = TRUE,
  rules_table = rules_table)
#fwrite(sibec.anal2, "./data/SIBEC_Analysis_data_2026.csv")
saveRDS(
  sibec.anal2,
  "./data/SIBEC_Analysis_data_2026.rds"
)

xx <- sibec.anal |> filter(BGC == "MSdc1")
xx <- sibec.anal2 |> filter(BGC == "MSdc1", TreeSpp == "Ba")
edatopic.grid2 <- add_predictors_sibec(
  edatopic.grid,
  add_asmr = TRUE,
  rules_table = rules_table,
  labels = labels)
#fwrite(edatopic.grid2, "./data/Predict_Edatopic_SI50_data_2026.csv")
saveRDS(
  edatopic.grid2,
  "./data/Predict_Edatopic_SI50_data_2026.rds"
)
